persons.name: Bālakṛṣṇa
persons.evidence: likhitaṃ āṃbekara ity upanāmakabālakṛṣṇena phaḍake ity upanāmakaśabhūnāthasya dattaṃ

relations.evidence: likhitaṃ āṃbekara ity upanāmakabālakṛṣṇena phaḍake ity upanāmakaśabhūnāthasya dattaṃ

notes: The year is written as 18023, an obvious scribal error for 1823 (VS 1823 ≈ 1766 CE). Both the scribe Bālakṛṣṇa and recipient Śambhūnātha have Maharashtrian Brahmin surnames (upanāman): Āmbekar and Phaḍke. Daśaratha from 'daśarathakṛtaṃ' is excluded as a mythical/puranic figure.
